name: Customer.io
label: Customer.io App API v1 — campaigns, profiles (Bearer)
description: Official Customer.io App API v1 at https://api.customer.io/v1. Handler: OfficialApiNode. App API key as Bearer (CRM read: campaigns, profile attributes/segments). Track API (identify/events/segment membership) is a different host and Basic auth — not this node. trigger.listen is BPMN ingress (reporting webhooks). Customer owns the workspace. app_api_key is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"campaign.list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: customer.get | customer.list | customer.search | customer.segments | campaign.list | campaign.get | campaign.metrics | segment.list | trigger.listen. customer.list is GET by email only; use customer.search to page profiles. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event, no socket).

schema.label: identifier
schema.description: Person id, email, or cio_… for customer.get / customer.segments. Percent-encode + in emails.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Required for customer.list (GET /customers). Lookup profiles matching this email. Encode + as %2B in the query string.

schema.label: period
schema.description: Optional metrics period per current App spec.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Required for customer.search. Official audience filter object (and/or/not, segment, attribute). POST /customers body.

schema.label: start
schema.description: customer.search pagination token from prior response next.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: customer.search query page size only (official max 1000). Ignored on customer.list (GET by email has no limit param).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Log ids only — bodies may contain PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: customer.get, customer.list, customer.search, customer.segments, campaign.list, campaign.get, campaign.metrics, segment.list, trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: App API key
configurationParameters.description: Customer.io App API key. Bearer on api.customer.io. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Api Host
configurationParameters.description: Customer.io App API host for your workspace region, interpolated into https://{api_host}/v1. EXACT: api.customer.io (US, default) | api-eu.customer.io (EU). Example: api-eu.customer.io.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
